.@mcuban says, "We're hearing more and more, particularly for larger companies, being afraid of how much they're spending on tokens and how much they're spending on AI. There's always a way that you can use it."

The billionaire sat down with the Lovable CEO & co-founder at the 2026 Raise Summit.

Video

Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh says AI spending had an "impressive growth rate" of nearly 25% in the first quarter.

Video
Jamie Dimon confirms his timeline to step down at JPMorgan remains a "few years" out. Recent management shakeups are just part of the long-term plan, not an exit strategy. yhoo.it/44ZVgBl

Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh says "America will be richer," and more productive from this AI cycle if it repeats prior positive technology trends.

Video

Kevin Warsh doesn't want the Fed to be in the "bailout business," and that includes crypto.

Video
On $JPM's earnings call, CEO Jamie Dimon said that competitive markets force companies to pass tech efficiencies down to the consumer, rather than just inflating corporate margins. yhoo.it/44ZVgBl

Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh said AI "is the most significant change in our economy in my adult lifetime," in a testimony before Congress on Tuesday.

"It's a huge opportunity, but it also comes with risks and challenges," Warsh added.

Video

Buybacks aren't just "returning capital" — they are an active investment decision, Jamie Dimon said on JPMorgan's Q2 earnings call Tuesday.

Dimon also added that companies need to stop hiding behind M&A and, instead, focus on organic growth. yhoo.it/44ZVgBl

Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh doubled down on his pledge to squelch inflation during his Congressional testimony.

Video
JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon was feeling pretty good about the bank's massive profits on its quarterly earnings call on Tuesday. yhoo.it/44ZVgBl
Growth in consumer prices cooled more than expected in June — albeit from an already high level — as drivers saw some relief at the pump. yhoo.it/4w1msvk

On a core basis, stripping out volatile categories like energy and food, prices were 2.6% higher than a year ago, and unchanged from May. yhoo.it/4w1msvk
Fresh data showed inflation declined 0.4% on a monthly basis in June, the largest single-month decline in more than six years. yhoo.it/4w1msvk

I asked JP Morgan CEO Jamie Dimon if an interest rate hike from the Fed would cause some of the risks he laid out in the earnings release today to collide. He laughed briefly and said:

“I wish I knew the answer to that question. We don't know. We're just isolating that there are issues out there. They're pretty important and substantial. You know, they can easily go away. They can easily collide in a way that will surprise you. And it won't just be the Fed and inflation. It might be a whole bunch of the geopolitical stuff, so just something to keep an eye on. Of course, we're always preparing for various types of risks.”
